== Course of events ==

Having already built a wooden body from saplings and bark, jointing it with pegs and fashioning a neck to hold the pumpkin head, Tip completes the figure by dressing it in clothes taken from Old Mombi's chest. He then gives the finished figure a name, calling him Jack Pumpkinhead.

The work takes place in the North of Oz, where Tip lives under the guardianship of Old Mombi, a woman suspected of magical arts and restricted by law of the ruling Good Witch to being a Sorceress or Wizardess rather than a true Witch. Tip carries out the dressing and naming even as he goes about his usual chores for Mombi—cutting wood, tending the corn-fields and pigs, and milking—slipping away to his own pursuits whenever her view of him is blocked.

The creation of Jack Pumpkinhead comes at a point when Tip openly hates Mombi and shows her little respect, and when he remembers nothing of his own parents, having been raised by Mombi since early childhood.
